keyPoints: Control the ventricular rate and start anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation with mitral stenosis, per the ESC valvular guideline
Restart secondary prophylaxis with benzathine penicillin G 1.2 million units by intramuscular injection every 4 weeks, per the WHO rheumatic heart disease guidance
Treat congestion with a loop diuretic and salt review while awaiting intervention
Refer to cardiology for balloon mitral valvotomy assessment as the valve is pliable without heavy calcification
Counsel about endocarditis precautions and close follow up in pregnancy, as stenosis worsens with the rise in cardiac output
management.model: Rate control plus anticoagulation, rheumatic prophylaxis, diuresis for congestion, and referral for balloon valvotomy

stem: A 24 year old woman from Madurai, a hostel student, presents with six months of worsening breathlessness and recent paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnoea. She recalls rheumatic fever at age 9 without regular prophylaxis. Her pulse is irregularly irregular and a mid diastolic rumble with an opening snap is heard at the apex.
teaching: Rheumatic mitral stenosis in a young woman is the classic Indian MBBS presentation, and atrial fibrillation appears once the left atrium enlarges
A loud first sound plus an opening snap plus a mid diastolic rumble is the bedside triad, best heard on the left side with the bell
Severe means valve area below 1.0 sq cm, and pregnancy markedly worsens symptoms as cardiac output rises
Secondary penicillin prophylaxis prevents recurrence, so every case is a chance to restart it
title: Rheumatic mitral stenosis with atrial fibrillation in a young woman
